Pendahuluan                                          Introduction

Kami    telah   mereviu   laporan   keuangan     We have  reviewed  the accompanying  interim
konsolidasian interim PT Bank Mandiri (Persero)       consolidated  financial  statements  of PT Bank
Tbk (“Bank”) dan entitas anaknya (secara kolektif       Mandiri  (Persero)  Tbk  (the  “Bank”)  and  its
disebut sebagai “Grup”) terlampir, yang terdiri       subsidiaries  (collectively  referred  to  as  the
dari laporan posisi keuangan konsolidasian interim       “Group”), which comprise the interim consolidated
tanggal 30 Juni 2026, serta laporan laba rugi dan      statement of financial position as of 30 June 2026,
penghasilan  komprehensif   lain  konsolidasian,      and the interim consolidated statement of profit or
laporan perubahan  ekuitas  konsolidasian, dan        loss   and   other   comprehensive   income,
laporan  arus  kas  konsolidasian  interim untuk       consolidated statement of changes in equity, and
periode enam bulan yang berakhir pada tanggal       consolidated statement of cash flows for the six-
tersebut, serta catatan atas laporan keuangan      month period then ended, and notes to the interim
konsolidasian   interim   termasuk   informasi       consolidated   financial   statements,   including
kebijakan   akuntansi    material.   Manajemen       material    accounting    policy    information.
bertanggung  jawab   atas  penyusunan  dan      Management is responsible for the preparation and
penyajian wajar laporan keuangan konsolidasian        fair  presentation  of  this  interim  consolidated
interim  ini  sesuai  dengan  Standar  Akuntansi        financial statements in accordance with Indonesian
Keuangan  di Indonesia. Tanggung jawab kami       Financial Accounting Standards. Our responsibility
adalah untuk menyatakan suatu kesimpulan atas         is  to  express  a  conclusion  on  this  interim
laporan  keuangan  konsolidasian  interim   ini       consolidated financial statements based on our
berdasarkan reviu kami.                                review.

Ruang lingkup reviu                              Scope of review

Kami  melaksanakan  reviu  kami  berdasarkan     We conducted our review  in accordance with
Standar  Perikatan  Reviu  2410,  “Reviu  atas      Standard on Review Engagements 2410, “Review
Informasi Keuangan Interim yang Dilaksanakan       of Interim Financial Information Performed by the
oleh Auditor Independen Entitas” (“SPR 2410”),      Independent Auditor of the Entity” (“SPR 2410”),
yang  ditetapkan  oleh  Institut Akuntan  Publik       established by the Indonesian Institute of Certified
Indonesia. Suatu reviu atas informasi keuangan       Public Accountants. A review of interim financial
interim   terdiri   dari  pengajuan  pertanyaan,       information consists of making inquiries, primarily
terutama kepada pihak yang bertanggung jawab       of persons responsible for financial and accounting
atas  bidang  keuangan  dan  akuntansi,  serta       matters, and applying analytical and other review
penerapan prosedur analitis dan prosedur reviu       procedures.
lainnya.
